title: Chameleon holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Tail: curled spiral -->
  <path d="M30 72 Q18 72 16 62 Q14 50 24 46 Q34 42 36 52 Q38 60 30 60 Q24 60 24 54" 
        fill="none" stroke="#3ddc84" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Tail lighter inner -->
  <path d="M28 70 Q19 70 18 62 Q17 53 24 49" 
        fill="none" stroke="#7dfcb2" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="62" rx="24" ry="15" fill="#3ddc84"/>
  <!-- Body lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="68" rx="18" ry="8" fill="#8affc1"/>

  <!-- Back ridge crest -->
  <path d="M36 52 L40 44 L46 50 L52 42 L58 50 L64 44 L68 52" 
        fill="none" stroke="#2bb86b" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="52" rx="15" ry="12" fill="#3ddc84"/>
  <!-- Head lighter cheek -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="56" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#8affc1"/>

  <!-- Casque / helmet crest -->
  <path d="M68 40 Q72 32 80 36 Q82 42 78 46" fill="#2bb86b"/>

  <!-- Eye: big and cute -->
  <circle cx="74" cy="50" r="6" fill="#e8fff4"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="50" r="3.5" fill="#1a5c38"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="49" r="1.5" fill="#d8ffe8"/>

  <!-- Mouth smile -->
  <path d="M78 58 Q82 60 84 57" fill="none" stroke="#1a7a48" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Front leg reaching to hold heart -->
  <path d="M62 66 Q64 74 60 78" fill="none" stroke="#3ddc84" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M60 78 Q58 80 60 82" fill="none" stroke="#2bb86b" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Back leg -->
  <path d="M42 70 Q40 78 44 82" fill="none" stroke="#3ddc84" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M44 82 Q46 84 44 86" fill="none" stroke="#2bb86b" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Other front leg -->
  <path d="M58 68 Q56 76 58 80" fill="none" stroke="#2bb86b" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Heart held in front -->
  <path d="M44 46 Q44 40 50 40 Q56 40 56 46 Q56 54 50 60 Q44 54 44 46 Z" 
        fill="#ff4d7a"/>
  <!-- Heart highlight -->
  <path d="M47 44 Q48 43 49 44" fill="none" stroke="#ffb3c8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Little spots on body -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="58" r="2" fill="#2bb86b"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="56" r="1.7" fill="#2bb86b"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="64" r="1.5" fill="#2bb86b"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="62" r="1.5" fill="#2bb86b"/>
</svg>
